name: Classic Victoria Sponge
description: The timeless English tea-time favorite: two light vanilla sponge layers filled with raspberry jam and buttercream, finished with a dusting of sugar.

name: Traditional Red Velvet
description: Deep cocoa-red layers with a tang of buttermilk, wrapped in silky cream cheese frosting — a Southern classic done the old-fashioned way.

name: Black Forest Gateau
description: Rich chocolate sponge layered with whipped cream, morello cherries, and a whisper of kirsch, topped with chocolate shavings.

name: Lemon Drizzle Loaf Cake
description: A moist lemon sponge soaked in a tart citrus syrup and topped with a crackly lemon glaze.

name: Old-Fashioned Carrot Cake
description: Spiced carrot cake studded with walnuts and finished with classic cream cheese frosting.

name: Traditional Fruit Cake
description: A dense, richly spiced fruit cake matured with brandy-soaked raisins, currants and candied peel — a wedding and Christmas heirloom recipe.

name: Coffee & Walnut Cake
description: Fluffy coffee-infused sponge layered with coffee buttercream and toasted walnuts.
